title: $\mu_0$: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
abstract: arXiv:2606.13769v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World models that capture how actions induce physical change enable scalable robot learning without reliance on embodiment-specific action labels. Pixel-space video models provide broad visual priors but expend model capacity on dense appearance reconstruction, while direct action models require embodiment-specific labels that hinder scalability. We present $\mu_0$, a scalable world model based on 3D traces. Rather than predicting dense pixels or directly modeling actions, $\mu_0$ forecasts smooth 3D trajectories for salient interaction points such as objects, tools, hands, and contact regions, yielding a compact, embodiment-agnostic motion interface. To enable training from diverse video sources, our TraceExtract system automatically extracts 3D supervision by selecting keypoints, constructing globally aligned traces, and associating motion segments with hierarchical language captions. translated_title: μ₀：可扩展的3D交互轨迹世界模型
translated_abstract: 能够捕捉动作如何引起物理变化的世界模型，使机器人学习无需依赖特定具身形态的动作标签即可实现规模化。像素空间视频模型提供了广泛的视觉先验，但会将模型容量耗费在密集的外观重建上；而直接动作模型则需要阻碍可扩展性的具身形态特定标签。我们提出了 μ₀，一个基于3D轨迹的可扩展世界模型。μ₀ 不预测密集像素或直接建模动作，而是为物体、工具、手和接触区域等显著交互点预测平滑的3D轨迹，从而形成一个紧凑的、与具身形态无关的运动接口。为了实现从多样化视频源进行训练，我们的 TraceExtract 系统通过选择关键点、构建全局对齐的轨迹，并将运动片段与分层语言描述相关联，自动提取3D监督。这种 TraceExtract 监督用于预训练……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: μ₀通过预测物体、工具、手等显著交互点的平滑3D轨迹（而非密集像素或具身特定动作标签）构建可扩展的世界模型，并借助TraceExtract系统从多样化视频源自动提取3D监督，实现与具身形态无关的机器人学习预训练。
en_tdlr: μ₀ is a scalable world model that predicts smooth 3D trajectories of salient interaction points instead of dense pixels or embodiment-specific action labels, with TraceExtract automatically extracting 3D supervision from diverse video sources to enable embodiment-agnostic robot learning.
